web.tour.alerts.text: {alerts} tells you about likes, comments, friend requests and your device. In {settings} you change your profile, password and language.
web.tour.alerts.title: Alerts and Settings
web.tour.collections.text: Keep photos that belong together in one place, like a trip or a birthday. In Images, select photos with the circle on each one (or press and hold), then choose {add}.
web.tour.done.text: See this tour again any time: choose {show} in the account menu, at the top right, or in Settings.
web.tour.done.title: You're all set
web.tour.files.text: Your documents and folders, kept on your device. Drag files onto the Files page to upload them, and click a file to open it.
web.tour.friends.accept: A request sent to you waits under {waiting}: choose {accept}.
web.tour.friends.add: To add a friend, type their device's name, the part before .{suffix}, under {heading} and choose {send}.
web.tour.friends.own: Your own address is in the account menu, under your name.
web.tour.images.text: All your photos and videos, newest first. Search at the top for places and things in your photos.
web.tour.menu.text: Everything is in the menu on the left. On a small screen, open it with the menu button at the top left.
web.tour.menu.title: Find your way
web.tour.people.text: The faces found in your photos, one person each. Choose {name} to name someone, and click a face to see all their photos.
web.tour.post.also: Or select photos in Images and choose {post}.
web.tour.post.step1: In Social, choose + {newPost} at the top.
web.tour.post.step2: Pick photos or videos from {library} (already on your device) or {computer}.
web.tour.post.title: Publish a post
web.tour.settings.hint: A short tour of Off The Cloud: your photos, posting to Social, friends and where everything is.
web.tour.settings.title: Getting started
web.tour.social.text: Your private feed with family and friends: like posts with the heart and comment on them. Your posts go from your device to your friends' devices, and only your friends see them.
web.tour.welcome.text: Your photos and files live on your own device, at home. Share them with family and friends in a private network of your own.
web.tour.welcome.title: Welcome to Off The Cloud
